messages:
auditor_ana: Hi team - ISO fieldwork asking for proof of the emergency RBAC escalation that happened on 2024-08-15. Need: 1) authoritative change record showing who applied and who reverted, 2) KMS key operation logs around the same window, 3) ticket linking the change to vulnerability triage, and 4) a short control map (which ISO control this maps to). Can we create a single package?

kevin_ops: We'll prepare. Change was role binding of 'svc-deploy' -> 'org-admin' for triage. Ticket: SEC-2024-0788. I'll pull CloudTrail event and the GitOps PR that requested the change.

nora_devsec: For KMS, key alias was alias/redwood-inference-ops (keyId=abcd-1111-ef22). We saw GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext and Decrypt calls at 2024-08-15T18:03:12Z and 18:05:01Z. I'll export the cloudtrail JSON for that KeyId and attach a CSV summary.

raj_oncall: Quick Splunk filter I used (I'll export raw + redacted):
```
index=cloudtrail serviceName=kms OR eventSource=iam.amazonaws.com userIdentity.arn="arn:aws:iam::*:user/svc-deploy" earliest="2024-08-15T17:50:00" latest="2024-08-15T18:20:00"
| sort _time
| table _time, eventName, requestParameters.userName, requestParameters.roleName, responseElements
```
I'll put screenshots and the JSON export into s3://redwood-compliance/tmp/SEC-2024-0788/ by EOD.

evidence-bot: Alert: automated change-detection flagged a bind of svc-deploy->org-admin at 2024-08-15T18:02:47Z (source=gitops-pr#4523).

kevin_ops: The GitOps PR is https://git.redwood/internal/infra/pr/4523 (contains approvers list and revert commit). I'll export the PR diff and the merge event.

auditor_ana: Originals required for audit validation, but redacted copies fine for initial upload. Please include a manifest with SHA256 for each file and a note describing redaction rules (IPs, hostnames removed). Also include a mapping file that states: "ISO 27001 Annex A.9.2.3 -> change control evidence" etc.

nora_devsec: Understood. We'll create: manifest.csv (filename, sha256, path), mapping.md (control -> artifact), redaction-script.sh, and originals/ & redacted/ buckets. We'll HMAC the manifest with the compliance key and include the HMAC in the bundle.

raj_oncall: ETA: I'll upload redacted exports + screenshots to s3://redwood-compliance/redacted/SEC-2024-0788/ by 1800 PST. Originals will be staged in s3://redwood-compliance/originals/SEC-2024-0788/ with restricted ACL and an access request process.

kevin_ops: Also note: we have a short timeline entry to include in mapping.md: 2024-08-15 17:55 UTC - vuln discovered (SEC-2024-0788); 18:00 UTC - emergency PR opened; 18:02 UTC - role bind applied; 18:10 UTC - triage complete; 18:15 UTC - revert PR merged.

auditor_ana: Good. Two asks: 1) include the exact CloudTrail eventId(s) in the manifest so auditors can cross-check, and 2) provide the PR approver list (to show emergency approval path).

nora_devsec: I'll include eventIds in manifest and a csv of approvers. Also adding a short note on why KMS ops were needed (decrypt for forensic artifact decryption during triage).

kevin_ops: Final packaging plan: create tar.gz of redacted artifacts + manifest + mapping.md + redaction-script.sh and upload to s3://redwood-compliance/packages/SEC-2024-0788-evidence.tar.gz. Post the SHA256 and HMAC here when done.

raj_oncall: Will post link + checksums when upload completes. :thumbsup:

auditor_ana: Thanks all. Ping me here when upload + checksums ready. We'll arrange secure review for originals under NDA.

kevin_ops: ping - uploaded redacted package: s3://redwood-compliance/packages/SEC-2024-0788-evidence.tar.gz
sha256: d2c7f0b5a8a9f6e3b1f2a5d6c7e8f9012a3b4c5d6e7f8901234567890abcdef12
hmac(manifest): hmac-sha256: a1b2c3d4e5f67890123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0

auditor_ana: Received. I'll schedule a validation session for originals next week. Thanks team! :pray!
